headline: WSP Global Reports Quarterly Profit Rise to $333.7 Million
summary: Montreal-based engineering firm WSP Global reported a quarterly profit of $333.7 million, up from the previous year, with revenue rising to $5.29 billion.
why: Engineering and professional services firms benefit from steady infrastructure spending and global project execution pipelines.
